headline: Bank of Greece: Accelerating Inflation Heralds Interest Rate Hikes – Market Sees Three Moves by End of 2027
summary: Greek services inflation rose to 6.4% from 4.5% in August, the greatest pressure in the data. Market pricing sees three rate moves by the end of 2027.
why: The Bank of Greece is the national central bank that sits within the euro system, so its inflation assessments inform expectations for ECB policy rates and Greek borrowing costs.
